study: retrospective fixed same-HF candidate acceptor benchmark; not a new confirmation
scale: Training-fold-only pooled RMS of non-top differences from original top candidate; <1e-12 replaced with 1
train_reference_denominator: N_l is the sum of reference words of training recordings in language l, including singleton banks.
risk: Implemented objective: sum_l sum_i sum_k softmax(theta dot (x/s)) * edits_ik / (5*N_l) + lambda*||theta||^2. This equals the paper negative-benefit objective up to a theta-independent constant; no extra factor of 100.
ranknet: Strictly unequal-edit pairs, logistic loss weighted 1/(5*N_l*number_of_pairs_in_bank), plus same L2 penalty. These weights are not renormalized to sum to one.
selection: Pooled out-of-fold hard five-language macro WER over all held folds; exact ties prefer larger lambda; all points retained
initialization: all zero for every lambda/fold and final fit
tie_at_inference: First candidate in original bank order via argmax.
test_use: None for fit/scaling/lambda. No confirmation labels are used.
inference_scope: Conditional on the fixed checkpoints, source draws, folds and fitted models; this is retrospective, not new confirmation.
